summary: OSR Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that it appealed Nasdaq's delisting determination by requesting a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel after failing to meet the minimum bid price requirement. The company previously received a second 180-day compliance period, so trading suspension remains scheduled for August 26, 2026, but the hearing request stays the Form 25-NSE filing pending the Panel's decision. OSR Health intends to present a plan to regain compliance, though no assurance of success exists. The filing contains forward-looking statements regarding the hearing outcome and listing status. What to watch: Panel decision timing, trading suspension execution, and ability to regain bid price compliance.
